newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SNAIGE PLANS PROFIT IN AUGUST AFTER H1 LOSS.
newsitem.headline: SNAIGE PLANS PROFIT IN AUGUST AFTER H1 LOSS.

text.p: Fridge producer Snaige said on Thursday that it would be in profit in August after ending the first half of the year with a loss.

"The firm was hit by the low German mark exchange rate during the first six months of the year since around 60 percent of our turnover is in German marks," Virginija Graudiniene, the finance director of the firm told Reuters.
"The demand for our products rises during summer months, the operating expenses for energy go down and turnover increases and we plan to have a profit in August," Graudiniene said.
The company said earlier that its turnover in the first half of 1997 was down to 63.6 million litas from 70.9 million litas in the same period last year.
Graudiniene said the firm was planning to end the summer with a profit.
The company has said it would boost its share capital by 40 million litas to 60 million litas when it moves into profit.

"According to our business plan we are considering investing into production around 40 million litas in the next five years but whether the money will be raised via a share issue or a bank credits should become known in September," Graudiniene said.
